generator: Built-in image_gen with project-original concept and prior sprite references. No CLI/API fallback and no third-party game assets.

rights.origin: Original AI-generated raster assets requested for Regavo, using project-original concept images as style/identity references.
rights.ownership: Usage follows the applicable OpenAI service terms. AI outputs are not guaranteed unique or exclusively copyrightable; no exclusive copyright warranty is made.
rights.thirdPartyAssets: None downloaded, traced or imported for this batch.

sourcePreservation: Every generated PNG was copied intact into public/art; original generated output remains under CODEX_HOME/generated_images. No offline image crop, paint, resample or alpha editing.

measurement.method: Read-only alpha >=180 connected components; nearest 4-column row cell assignment; recorded source rectangles and opaque lower boot/hoof mass x pivot. Source rectangles are sampled only at runtime.
measurement.bodyRefs: Source body reference heights are per matching type/contact pair to preserve adult/horse/elephant scale. Siege references remain constant across all four states.

runtime.pixelRatioMeaning: Runtime texture density only; source PNGs preserve native dimensions.
runtime.output: Alpha-trimmed canvas; anchor coordinates are physical canvas pixels, logical dimensions = canvas dimensions /4. Original full-pose buffer accommodates weapons and elephant trunk.
runtime.animation: Whole authored pose sampling only; no limb/head rectangular slicing, warping, rotating or repeated filter pass. Native source samples receive one high-quality filter, then physical-pixel 1:1 snapped blits. Cached poses and final textures are runtime alpha-trimmed. Source isolation removes distant components smaller than4% of main actor while retaining nearby tips/faint edges. Pose cache stores alpha-trimmed images plus12logical-pixel margins.
runtime.walking: 2 authored whole contacts per class; elephant A/B/C/B. Runtime animation frame0/1 contactA, frame2/3 contactB. No claim of full interpolated skeleton gait.
runtime.combat: frame0/1 authored windup/draw/aim, frame2 impact/release/fire, frame3 recovery; bow keeps release stance and gun keeps aimed stance. Siege machine and crew source states change together.
runtime.team: Small code-painted turquoise or red team pennant; faction identity stays in full outfits and tack.
runtime.carry: Villager carry is explicit action only; default idle/walk holds appropriate tools. Existing v2 sack/wood sources retained; sack resource symbols are code-painted. Carry retains a restrained whole-image motion, not authored cargo leg contacts. Roman engineer uses explicit Roman sack/wood carry before its ordinary tool-pose branch.
runtime.loader: loadUnitAtlases(civs?: readonly string[]):Promise<boolean>. No argument loads all5. A civ list loads common sources + requested faction/special sheets, evicts other decoded faction sources after completion. Same selection coalesces; superseded request cannot assign/prune latest maps.
runtime.portrait: Native high-resolution source frame directly sampled into512x576 canvas, independent of world sprite scale.

retainedWalking: legionary: existing authored infantry action pair
coverage.villagerActions: Existing complete tool/work poses retained; village default/newly spawned/empty walk uses tools, cargo only explicit carry. Roman/Mongol/Ottoman idle and portraits use tool action row0; Persian/Tang use their dedicated unladen tool sheets.

limitations: Four diagonal headings, neighboring diagonal source for cardinal movement.
Walking has2 authored contacts (elephant3), not continuous skeletal interpolation.
Matching gear/anatomy stays cohesive but independently authored poses may vary slightly in folds, armor detail and painterly scale.
Assets represent faction military outfits, without3 distinct military outfit sets per age. Buildings retain their independent3age architecture.
Carry has original cargo whole stance plus restrained motion; no new cargo leg-contact sheets.
Visual projectile/slash/muzzle event timing is implemented by the parent scene/workshop, not this source sampler.
Version6 trader and siege construction/crew palettes are shared references; requested faction trader/siege variants follow in version7.
